text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week has vowed to bring the
spring shield of the Tenno Sho
back to
Team Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if to affirm that promise,
she begins
to work even harder
during our training
sessions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first,
this was just another objective I
set for her—another goal to
work towards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But after hearing how much this race
means to her teammates, this race has
taken on a whole new meaning for Special
Week. She's determined to snag the shield
and make this a race we won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we keep on training until at long
last...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We've been blessed with clear skies here
today at Kyoto Racecourse. Under the
shining sun, twelve Umamusume will vie for
the glory of the
spring shield.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And of course, the name on everyone's lips
is last year's champion,
Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean we're ignoring her
challengers, like the Kikuka
Sho
Umamusume Seiun Sky and the Derby
Umamusume Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining the showdown these three
are about to show us has
the audience on
the edge of their seats!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe, good luck out there! Show us a spring
Tenno Sho as inspiring as
McQueen's!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm planning on conquering this race myself someday, so run like I'm right on your heels!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll give you a race worth watching!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? That your phone?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's a message from Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
"I've got the livestream going
over here. Good luck,
Spee." Spee?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's late over there, so she must've
mistyped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm sure she's tired,
but she's still
watching regardless. That just
shows how
much she cares.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And she's not the only one cheering for
you!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We know you'll be leading the pack by the
end!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you run anything like you did at
practice, you'll win. All you need
now is
confidence.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you run anything like you did at
practice, you'll win. All you need
now is
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right! With my moms' dream, my own
dream, and Team Sirius on my
side, there's
no way I can lose!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Long time, no see. Last time we ran
together was the Kikuka Sho,
right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I won that race, but who knows what'll
happen today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Especially considering the look in your
eye has changed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I've got lots of hopes and dreams
riding on today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I could say the very same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No matter the opponent, I have focused
only on achieving what I
must... I thought
that was more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, Seiun Sky, you have bested me
before. As have you,
Special Week, in our
last race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I understand now that you two have skills
worthy of the Golden Generation title. But
know that I will emerge from this race

triumphant!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I dunno,
I'll be trying pretty hard myself...
But I suppose we'll find out
during the
race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's give this race our all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I would expect nothing less!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All righty then, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
As we speak, twelve contenders are
bracing themselves for the
grueling
3,200-meter battle ahead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will the reigning champion come away
with another victory? Or will it
be one of
the two challengers from the Golden
Generation?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
With each racer now in the starting gate,
the spring Tenno Sho...
begins!
